name: Fugas
description: He in no way resembled Torque, the irritating but harmless "deovel" the Witcher, Geralt encountered many, many years prior. Fugas' size resembled that of a somewhat overgrown troll, and he likewise displayed a troll's lack of subtlety. There was not a jot of mischievous puck or cunning verbal trickster about this "devil."
story: The devil Fugas held a very prestigious and responsible position during the Crones' sabbath: that of goon restricting access to the peak of Bald Mountain.
lore: Instead, he carried out his task with the commitment and professionalism of a Novigrad bouncer.
habitat: Primeval forests, forgotten ruins, and places of old power
